protocol_details.infeasible_quota_policy: fail; never split a group, delete, or resample images
protocol_details.integer_rule: within each stratum: floor(0.8*N), floor(0.1*N), remainder

labels.empty_label_policy: retain; every image must still have a source TXT file
labels.format: YOLO normalized class x_center y_center width height
labels.semantic_comparison: sorted exact rational-valued boxes; numeric spelling, whitespace, line endings and row order do not matter; no rounding or clipping
labels.source_mutation: none, including no newline or coordinate normalization
labels.validation: ASCII numeric text; exactly five finite numeric values per nonblank line; integer class 0; centers in [0,1]; widths/heights in (0,1]; valid normalized xywh edge boxes may have corners beyond [0,1]; raw extents retained, native Ultralytics augmentation clipping unchanged; duplicate semantic/float32 boxes, float32-degenerate boxes and loader-incompatible internal whitespace-only lines rejected

limitations: Image-level content grouping is not proof of scene/source independence.
No near-duplicate or scene mapping is inferred from numeric filenames.
This full-data protocol is separate from the historical positive-only 795/44/44.
Readiness is a point-in-time audit; consumers must revalidate mutable sources.
protocol_details.ordering: SHA256 rank of [20261012, namespace, pixel_sha256]; no training seed
protocol_details.pixel_sha256: SHA256(canonical JSON of RGB mode/width/height + PIL-decoded RGB bytes)
protocol_details.scope: all 2966 source images, including 2083 negative images
protocol_details.split_unit: complete exact decoded RGB content group within each stratum
protocol_details.storage: absolute symlinks to original image/label files; no source writes
protocol_details.stratification: positive iff a valid source label contains at least one box
